sourceNotes.rawContent: Fit for a queen — this extraordinary Kashmiri bracelet watch is a true work of art featuring a bold kundan crown charm on top, intricate pink & red meenakari square panels with pearl borders, a heavily CZ-encrusted dial, and a multicolour chand pendant with cascading ghungroo chains below. Every element tells a story of royal Indian craftsmanship. An absolute showstopper for brides, sangeet nights, and grand festive celebrations.
